title: Record OFF checkpoint capacity refusal as unsent while preserving containment
outcome: OFF containment applies its false flag and dispatch exclusion even when custody is unavailable, while its retained phase truthfully distinguishes an unsent checkpoint.
acceptance: Decide bounded reply custody before publishing the OFF checkpoint send intent, through the existing containment and receipt owners.

When custody is unavailable, retain an Intended unsent duty and capacity reason while still durably applying OFF and exclusions; do not manufacture settlement, dispatch authority or a generic replay scheduler.
Cover shared-slot and byte-cap refusals, successful reserved sends, rollback and guard release; obtain focused validation and independent review.
